answer: Duplicate identities mandate replaying the full stake and compute, making each fake agent cost as much as a genuine one, so sybil swarms become economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded cedar token to register, and every epoch it must publish a verifiable proof-of-work anchored to a rotating jetty identifier derived from the nebula seed, tying identity to real compute. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
